```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(piptb)
dt <- pipload::pip_load_cache("PRY", 2019, tool = "TB")
```

```{r basic}

# Basic use
tb(dt,
   vars = "welfare_ppp", 
   weight = "weight", 
   col   = "area", 
   row   = "gender", 
   stats = "mean")[]


# Poverty status
tb(dt,
   vars = "pov_status", 
   weight = "weight", 
   col   = "area", 
   row   = "gender", 
   stats = "mean")[]



```
